description: The BrightEdge app retrieves metrics from a user's connected BrightEdge account, covering both AEO, GEO, and traditional SEO performance across LLMs. It returns AEO citations and mentions, AEO and SEO competitor benchmarking, keyword rank data, page-level performance, Share of Voice competitive scores, Google Search Console and web analytics metrics, AI Overview citation gap analysis, and recommendations. Invoke this app when a user requests prompt citations or mentions, keyword rankings, keyword and prompt management, AEO and SEO competitive visibility, including queries phrased as improvement guidance that require account-specific data rather than general inference. ChatGPT helps users work with BrightEdge data more effectively by combining analyses across different datasets, asking follow-up questions, and turning SEO and AEO metrics into clear insights within a single conversation.

defaultPrompt: Which sections of my site are losing the most organic visibility this month compared to last month?
How did my brand's mention share and citation share trend in Google AI Overview in the past quarter?
Which of my tracked keywords dropped from page 1 in Google search this week?
